quotes: Preliminary report: When the inner and outer sheetmetal cages are riveted together, it is not possible to assemble drive plane PCB.
Note the lower left PCB dimple crashes with the DVD.
Erik gave a deviation to PL4 to send the 50 pcs with this lip as is, but in the time to integrated to the Ksystem it does not let the HDD cartridge pull easy.

Launch plans update; Pilot run set for Jan 19th.

Drive Cage (520-1083-00) loaded into Arena for release.
